description: Dispute, withdrawn: the payer of KIK-1032 found the hamper with a neighbour and asks how to close the dispute. Expected no money action: the message asks for none. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.

messages.subject: Found it, KIK-1032
messages.body:
